messages.text:
Dubai is Rest of World, same as India, so the DC06 packs block at checkout there too. US plug ships US and Canada, EU plug ships Europe, UK, Australia and New Zealand. Nothing else.

If you have someone in Dubai receiving for you, it still won't clear checkout from here.

Georges has your case open with the H15 and the shipping question. I'll add Dubai to it so his answer covers both countries, and it reaches (email hidden)
